### [Introducing the Grid Protectors Program](https://openai.com/index/grid-protectors-program)

**OpenAI** · 2026-11-02

OpenAI has launched the Grid Protectors Program to collaborate with electric utilities on power grid reliability and electricity cost management for future compute campuses.

- Partners directly with electric utilities to integrate future compute campuses into existing power infrastructure.
- Aims to maintain power grid reliability as compute demand increases.
- Focuses on protecting electricity costs for consumers.

**Why it matters:** The program addresses energy infrastructure and cost challenges associated with scaling power-intensive compute infrastructure.

### [The U.S. Census Bureau and “Super Intelligence”](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/2/census-bureau-super-intelligence/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-11-02

The U.S. Census Bureau updated its Business Trends and Outlook Survey AI question wording and rebranded "Artificial Intelligence" to "Super Intelligence" to comply with Executive Order 14434.

- U.S. Census Bureau Business Trends and Outlook Survey (BTOS) surveys a rotating panel of 200,000 businesses out of 1.2 million total every two weeks.
- On November 17, 2025, the survey broadened its AI usage question from using AI "in producing goods or services" to "in any of its business functions", making historical data comparisons non-direct.
- Reported AI adoption for large companies (250+ employees) rose from roughly 12% in September 2025 under the original wording to ~30% in February 2026 and ~40% by October 2026 under the expanded definition.
- Beginning October 19, 2026, Executive Order 14434 forced BTOS to update survey language from "Artificial Intelligence or AI" to "Super Intelligence or SI".

**Why it matters:** Changes to federal survey scope and terminology create metric discontinuities, complicating accurate tracking of enterprise AI adoption trends over time.

`ai-adoption` `census-bureau` `btos` `data-analysis`
